claims.codex: constant-density phi minimum unique and positive at every F (ed73791)
claims.ours: No: unique root S(F) in (0,1) for every F>0 (dF^2/dS <= -4.66, no negative root), unique stationary F at every density (G(F)=F^4(S^2+aF^2) strictly increasing), fixed-n Hessian positive everywhere (eigs 0.94-14). Tilt moves the interior from S=0 (bag 75 m_X^4) to S_c=0.1258 (86.0 m_X^4), bulk Omega 0.7401 -> 0.7759
